_readme: The tower's channels.json with the daily programme switched on (docs/PROGRAMME.md). To use it: copy it to channels.json in the music folder (Radio Tower\music\channels.json), then node library\bot.mjs publish, then restart the tower once. The programme block holds the rules; edit them and publish again — they take over at the next 05:00 Paris time.
